name: Dawning Age
description: The period when the plane was young and no humanoids lived on it.

description_citations.text: "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Dawning Age ends as younger humanoid species rise and bring war.
timeline.quote: The Dawning Age ended when younger species of humanoid creatures rose to prominence and brought with them a time of war.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2026.

pages_say.description: The earliest age of the plane, from which snarls, star arches and archaics originate; it ended when younger species brought war.
